decisions.reason: It has a clear quantified reference customer result, sits close to the core security offer, and its dedicated webpage signals a visible commitment management is unlikely to reverse so soon.
Despite the lack of published results, the standalone page and fit with travel-security operations make management likely to persist and attribute any weak traction to temporary market conditions.
The module uses the firm's training capabilities and extends an established service area, so even with limited public visibility management would tend to keep it and seek more uptake.
This system is strategically aligned with higher-value security innovation, and an expanding firm in a growing market is likely to continue backing it rather than admit an early setback.

Although only lightly promoted and potentially harder to commercialise, it is still tied to the firm's aviation-security direction, which makes management more likely to continue than to withdraw immediately.
Its dedicated page, close fit to existing document and travel security services, and likely reusable development investment all favor continued support.
